user.title: AlphaESS battery
user.description: Pick your inverter from the AlphaESS Modbus TCP integration. State of charge, capacity and house load are found automatically.

data_description.device_id: The inverter from AlphaESS Modbus TCP. State of charge, capacity and house load are found on it automatically.
data_description.power_kw: Highest charge/discharge power. See select.…_inverter_ac_limit or your datasheet.
data_description.floor_pct: SoC where the inverter stops discharging. See number.…_discharging_cutoff_soc.
data_description.max_soc_pct: Highest SoC to charge to from the grid. Not above number.…_charging_cutoff_soc.
data_description.eta: Share of energy kept per direction. 0.95 is about 90% round trip; leave it unless you measured it.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Nord Pool sensor (HACS version) with `raw_today` and `raw_tomorrow` attributes.

data.price_all_in: Price already includes tax, fees and VAT
data.netting_deduction: Deduction on feed-in price during netting

data_description.price_entity: Price sensor from the community Nord Pool integration (needs raw_today).
data_description.price_all_in: On if the sensor shows what you pay per kWh, including fees, energy tax and VAT.
data_description.fee_in: What your supplier adds per kWh bought, excluding VAT (inkoopvergoeding).
data_description.fee_out: What your supplier deducts per kWh exported once netting has ended (2027).
data_description.netting_deduction: Under netting (2026): fixed amount deducted from the feed-in price. 0 if you get the full price back.
data_description.vat_pct: VAT on electricity, 21% in the Netherlands.

solar.title: Solar (optional)
solar.description: Forecast of the remaining solar production today. The charge ceiling leaves room for it.

data_description.pv_remaining_entity: Expected solar yield for the rest of today in kWh. The battery keeps room for it.

usage.title: Consumption
usage.description: The consumption profile is built from the long-term statistics of the house load (last 28 days, weekday and weekend apart).

data.ev_power_entity: EV charging power (subtracted from the profile)

data_description.ev_power_entity: Power sensor of your car charger. Subtracted from the house profile.
data_description.holiday_entity: On while you're away. The profile is then multiplied by the factor below.
data_description.holiday_factor: Share of normal use while away. 0.45 = 45%.
data_description.yearly_kwh: From your energy bill. Only used until there are two weeks of statistics.

error.entities_not_found: State of charge, capacity or house load not found on this device.
error.no_raw_today: This sensor has no raw_today attribute. Use the Nord Pool integration from HACS.

abort.alphaess_missing: Install and set up the AlphaESS Modbus TCP integration first.
abort.nordpool_missing: Install and set up the Nord Pool integration from HACS first.
